name: io.github.avaazquezz/mcp-qdrant
description: The full Qdrant API as 56 MCP tools, plus plain-text semantic, BM25 and hybrid search.
title: Qdrant MCP

environmentVariables.description: Qdrant server URL, e.g. http://localhost:6333 (mutually exclusive with QDRANT_LOCAL_PATH)
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_URL

environmentVariables.description: Qdrant API key, if your instance requires one
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Path to an embedded Qdrant instance, instead of a URL
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_LOCAL_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable: core, search, payload, admin, snapshots, observability
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_MCP_TOOLSETS

environmentVariables.description: Remove every tool not marked read-only from the registry
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_MCP_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Largest number of points one tool call may ask for (minimum 30); bigger requests are refused, not cut
environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_MCP_MAX_LIMIT
QDRANT_MCP_SNAPSHOT_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated http(s) origins qdrant_snapshot_recover may restore from, besides file:// and QDRANT_URL's own origin

environmentVariables.name: FASTEMBED_CACHE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Where text-embedding models are cached (semantic search needs the mcp-qdrant[embeddings] extra)
